nodes.label_zh: 云厂商AI资本开支承诺
nodes.rationale: Hyperscaler (MSFT/Alphabet/AMZN/Meta/ORCL) annual capex is the demand pool for the AI buildout; commitments lead chip revenue ~2-4 quarters.

nodes.label_zh: 先进算力芯片供给
nodes.rationale: HBM and leading-edge GPU/accelerator capacity is the binding constraint on AI infrastructure buildout pace.

nodes.label_zh: AI加速器与算力芯片
nodes.rationale: Basket members capture the direct revenue pool: accelerators, networking silicon, and HBM directly consumed by hyperscaler capex.

nodes.label_zh: 晶圆制造设备（WFE）
nodes.rationale: WFE spend is a lagged step back in the capex chain; wafer starts committed today convert to equipment orders 1-3 quarters prior.

nodes.label_zh: 数据中心供电与散热
nodes.rationale: Power and cooling demand is an indirect but durable beneficiary of capacity additions; PUE improvements slow the intensity but not the absolute MW demand.

nodes.label_zh: 成熟制程半导体
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: capex concentration in leading-edge AI compute crowds out pricing leverage for commodity/mature-node producers; overcapacity risk in trailing nodes.

nodes.label_zh: 电网与电气化建设（二阶）
nodes.rationale: Datacenter power demand growth outpaces incremental renewable capacity; grid interconnection queue is the second-order binding constraint.

edges.rationale: Hyperscaler capex commitments directly translate to accelerator orders within 1-2 quarters.
Revenue flows directly into accelerator/networking silicon basket members.
Leading-edge capacity additions require WFE spend; lag is 1-3 quarters.
Compute density growth increases per-rack power draw and cooling requirements.
AVOID-shaped: capex concentrated at leading edge reduces pricing leverage in mature nodes; trailing-edge basket members face structural headwinds.
MW demand growth from AI datacenters is a second-order tailwind for grid capex; interconnection backlogs are the binding constraint.

nodes.label_zh: AI训练内存需求（HBM）
nodes.rationale: Each successive AI model generation requires more HBM bandwidth per accelerator; demand is near-exclusively driven by the AI buildout.

nodes.label_zh: HBM产能（CoWoS先进封装）
nodes.rationale: CoWoS advanced packaging capacity is the physical binding constraint on HBM output; qualification lead times stretch 6-12 months.

nodes.label_zh: 存储与HBM生产商
nodes.rationale: Basket members are the primary revenue recipients of HBM pricing power during capacity-constrained periods.

nodes.label_zh: NAND与通用DRAM供给过剩
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: capex pivot to HBM within the same fabs draws down NAND and commodity DRAM capacity; oversupply risk persists in non-AI memory segments.

edges.rationale: AI training workload growth is the primary demand driver for HBM.
Constrained HBM supply with growing AI demand supports pricing for basket members.
AVOID-shaped: fab time redirected to HBM reduces commodity memory output but also risk/reward for non-AI memory in the same basket.

nodes.label_zh: 先进制程晶圆厂投资决策
nodes.rationale: Fab build/expansion commitments by leading-edge foundries and IDMs are the demand source for WFE; orders follow commitment decisions by 1-4 quarters.

nodes.label_zh: EUV光刻产能
nodes.rationale: EUV tools are the capacity-constrained item in advanced node fabs; lead times extend to 18-24 months.

nodes.label_zh: 晶圆制造设备商
nodes.rationale: Basket members capture WFE orders directly; book-to-bill is the leading revenue signal.

nodes.label_zh: 工艺材料与特种气体
nodes.rationale: Process chemistry and specialty gases see volume uplift from increased wafer starts but lack the pricing leverage of equipment suppliers.

edges.rationale: Fab investment decisions convert to EUV tool orders within 1-4 quarters.
EUV and supporting WFE revenues flow directly to basket members.
Higher wafer starts lift process materials consumption as a second-order effect.

nodes.label_zh: 云厂商与新云算力电力采购
nodes.rationale: Hyperscaler and neocloud operators are signing long-term power purchase agreements; MW procurement is the pipeline metric.

nodes.label_zh: 电网接入与许可审批
nodes.rationale: FERC interconnection queue and state permitting timelines are the binding constraint on new datacenter power delivery; average queue wait has grown to 3-5 years.

nodes.label_zh: 数据中心供电与冷却设备
nodes.rationale: Basket members provide transformers, UPS, cooling units, and liquid cooling directly consumed by datacenter builds.

nodes.label_zh: 核能与小型模块堆发电
nodes.rationale: 24/7 carbon-free power demand from hyperscalers is a structural tailwind for nuclear PPA agreements and SMR development timelines.

nodes.label_zh: 柴油备用发电设备商
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: hyperscaler sustainability commitments and carbon targets are displacing diesel backup generation with battery and cleaner alternatives.

edges.rationale: AVOID-shaped: permitting/interconnection backlog is slowing delivery; projects with secured interconnection command premium.
Power procurement commitments convert to equipment orders for cooling and power infrastructure.
24/7 power demand drives hyperscaler interest in nuclear PPAs and SMR partnerships.
AVOID-shaped: decarbonization mandates and battery storage are reducing the role of diesel backup generation.

nodes.label_zh: 企业全天候清洁电力需求
nodes.rationale: Hyperscaler sustainability commitments and AI power growth are driving demand for 24/7 carbon-free electricity, channeling interest to nuclear PPAs.

nodes.label_zh: 铀供给（浓缩与转化）
nodes.rationale: Enrichment and conversion capacity is the supply-chain bottleneck; Western enrichment capacity is constrained post-Russia sanctions.

nodes.label_zh: 核电运营商与小型模块堆开发商
nodes.rationale: Basket members include utility-scale nuclear operators with PPAs and SMR technology developers with growing order books.

nodes.label_zh: 铀矿开采商
nodes.rationale: Uranium mining supply is the feedstock input; miners benefit from structural long-term contract demand.

nodes.label_zh: 天然气调峰电厂
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: long-duration clean power PPAs reduce the economics for gas peakers in competitive power markets.

edges.rationale: New reactor commitments and SMR deals increase long-term uranium demand, tightening enrichment capacity.
Uranium supply tightness flows through to miner revenue via long-term contract pricing.
Hyperscaler PPAs and SMR development agreements underpin order books for nuclear basket members.
AVOID-shaped: structural shift to 24/7 carbon-free power reduces relative competitiveness of gas peakers in forward capacity markets.

nodes.label_en: US grid investment legislation & datacenter load growth
nodes.label_zh: 美国电网投资立法与数据中心负荷增长
nodes.rationale: IRA-driven transmission investment and datacenters' surging load growth are the dual demand drivers for grid buildout spending.

nodes.label_zh: 高压变压器供给
nodes.rationale: Lead times for large power transformers have extended to 2-3 years; capacity is concentrated among a small number of domestic/allied producers.

nodes.label_zh: 电网设备与工程总包
nodes.rationale: Basket members are direct revenue recipients of transmission and distribution capex.

nodes.label_zh: 铜线缆
nodes.rationale: Grid transmission expansion is highly copper-intensive; cable and conductor demand is a durable second-order beneficiary.

nodes.label_zh: 煤电调度
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: grid modernization and renewable integration accelerate coal plant retirements.

edges.rationale: Grid investment converts to transformer orders; supply tightness enhances pricing power for domestic producers.
Equipment demand flows to basket members as the primary supply source.
Grid expansion is copper-intensive; each GW of transmission requires substantial copper cable and conductors.
AVOID-shaped: grid modernization and renewable penetration reduce coal's dispatch hours and capacity value.

nodes.label_zh: AI时代威胁面扩展
nodes.rationale: AI adoption expands the attack surface through new attack vectors, model poisoning, and proliferation of autonomous threat actors; compliance mandates follow.

nodes.label_zh: 网络安全人才与认证稀缺
nodes.rationale: Certified security professionals are in structural deficit; platform consolidation is one response — advantaging large integrated vendors.

nodes.label_zh: 网络安全平台厂商
nodes.rationale: Basket members capture the enterprise security budget directed at AI-native threat prevention, SOC automation, and identity security.

nodes.label_zh: 传统本地SIEM与单点产品厂商
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: platform consolidation and AI-native threat detection erode revenue for legacy on-premise point-product vendors.

edges.rationale: Talent scarcity advantages platform vendors offering automation; enterprises consolidate on fewer integrated solutions.
Platform consolidation and AI-native security products flow revenue to basket members.
AVOID-shaped: legacy point-product spend is being consolidated away; margin compression risk for non-platform players.

nodes.label_en: NATO re-armament & allied defense budget expansion
nodes.label_zh: 北约重整军备与盟友防务预算扩张
nodes.rationale: Allied defense spending commitments (NATO 2% GDP+ targets) and US supplemental appropriations are the primary demand driver for defense systems.

nodes.label_zh: 导弹与弹药推进系统供给
nodes.rationale: Solid rocket motor and propulsion component production is the primary production bottleneck for guided munitions replenishment.

nodes.label_zh: 国防主承包商
nodes.rationale: Basket members are the primary revenue recipients of re-armament and systems modernization programs.

nodes.label_zh: 国防传感器、电子与指控系统
nodes.rationale: Sensors, radars, electronic warfare systems, and command/control electronics are the enabling sub-systems for modern defense platforms.

nodes.label_zh: 军民两用技术（AI与自主系统）
nodes.rationale: Autonomous systems and AI-chip content in defense platforms create second-order demand linkage to civilian AI and robotics baskets.

edges.rationale: Re-armament spending translates to munitions orders constrained by propulsion supply.
Defense primes are primary contractors for re-armament programs.
Platform modernization programs pull through sensor and electronics sub-system orders.
AI autonomy content in defense platforms creates second-order linkage to civilian AI semiconductor and robotics baskets.

nodes.label_zh: 劳动力成本与回岸制造自动化投资
nodes.rationale: Persistent wage inflation and onshoring mandates are compressing margins for manufacturers, accelerating the ROI hurdle for automation capital spending.

nodes.label_zh: 精密执行器与伺服电机
nodes.rationale: High-precision actuators and servo drives are the primary lead-time-constrained components in industrial robot delivery.

nodes.label_zh: 工业机器人与协作机器人
nodes.rationale: Basket members are the direct revenue recipients of factory automation capex; cobot adoption is expanding the addressable market.

nodes.label_zh: AI视觉与感知软件
nodes.rationale: Robotic systems increasingly embed AI vision; demand for perception chips and software is a downstream winner.

nodes.label_zh: 劳动密集型组装作业
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: automation ROI competes directly with labor-intensive operations; companies with high manual assembly ratios face structural margin pressure.

edges.rationale: Automation capex demand meets actuator supply constraints; lead times extend delivery timelines.
Robot and cobot orders flow to basket members once component supply permits.
AI-enabled robots pull through AI vision chip and perception software demand.
AVOID-shaped: automation investment substitutes for manual assembly labor; affected sub-sectors face structural cost base displacement.

nodes.label_en: GLP-1 weight-loss drug demand & formulary access
nodes.label_zh: GLP-1减重药需求与医保覆盖
nodes.rationale: Clinically demonstrated weight reduction and cardiovascular benefit are driving formulary inclusion and payer negotiation; patient pipeline is structural.

nodes.label_zh: 灌装封装与给药装置制造
nodes.rationale: Auto-injector device manufacturing and fill-finish sterile capacity are the binding constraints on GLP-1 supply scaling.

nodes.label_zh: GLP-1药物研发商与制造商
nodes.rationale: Basket members are the primary revenue recipients of prescription volumes and net pricing once payer coverage broadens.

nodes.label_en: Medical devices benefiting from obesity reduction
nodes.label_zh: 受益于肥胖率下降的医疗器械
nodes.rationale: Reduction in obesity-related comorbidities is a second-order tailwind for managed care cost reduction, though it may reduce procedure volumes for device makers.

nodes.label_zh: 减重手术及相关医疗器械
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: widespread GLP-1 adoption is evidence the surgical alternative faces demand displacement; procedure volume data is the observable.

nodes.label_zh: 高热量包装食品与零食行业
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: population-level caloric intake reduction from GLP-1 adoption is a volume headwind for high-calorie packaged food manufacturers; structural, not cyclical.

edges.rationale: Demand growth converts to fill-finish capacity investment; bottleneck suppliers command pricing power.
Revenue flows to GLP-1 developers once manufacturing capacity scales.
Comorbidity reduction may lower managed care cost structures over multi-year horizons.
AVOID-shaped: GLP-1 adoption displaces bariatric procedure demand; procedure volume trends are the observable.
AVOID-shaped: population-level GLP-1 adoption is a structural volume headwind for high-calorie food; observable via category scanner data.

nodes.label_en: Digital payments volume & real-time payment rail adoption
nodes.label_zh: 数字支付量与实时支付轨道采用
nodes.rationale: Global cashless payment volume growth and real-time payment rail (FedNow, RTP) adoption are structural demand drivers for payment infrastructure.

nodes.label_zh: 监管合规与银行牌照限制
nodes.rationale: Licensing, AML/KYC requirements, and banking charter constraints are the primary barriers to new entrant scaling.

nodes.label_zh: 支付网络与金融科技使能商
nodes.rationale: Basket members capture payment volume economics and software subscription revenue from embedded finance adoption.

nodes.label_zh: 现金处理与支票清算传统机构
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: secular shift to digital payments structurally reduces cash and check volume handled by legacy processors.

edges.rationale: AVOID-shaped: compliance costs are a structural barrier that advantages large incumbents over new entrants.
Compliance moat advantages scaled payment networks with existing licensing and rails.
AVOID-shaped: cashless volume growth structurally reduces cash and check volume for legacy processors.

nodes.label_zh: 低地球轨道星座建设与发射节奏
nodes.rationale: LEO constellation deployment and reusable launch cost reductions are enabling commercial satellite services; launch cadence is the pipeline proxy.

nodes.label_zh: 频谱许可与轨道位资源分配
nodes.rationale: ITU orbital slot and spectrum licensing are finite resources; incumbents with allocated rights have a regulatory moat.

nodes.label_zh: 卫星运营商与发射服务商
nodes.rationale: Basket members capture the revenue from satellite connectivity services and launch vehicle utilization.

nodes.label_zh: 地面设备与终端制造商
nodes.rationale: Growing constellation subscriber base drives terminal and ground station hardware demand.

nodes.label_zh: 传统高延迟GEO卫星运营商
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: LEO connectivity with low latency is displacing GEO satellite for broadband applications; GEO operators face structural revenue pressure.

edges.rationale: Spectrum scarcity advantages incumbents with existing orbital/spectrum rights.
Licensed operators convert spectrum access into service revenue.
Subscriber base growth drives terminal hardware demand from basket members.
AVOID-shaped: LEO latency advantage is displacing GEO for broadband; subscription revenue migration is the observable.

nodes.label_en: EV / battery & defense supply chain diversification mandates
nodes.label_zh: 电动车/电池与国防供应链多元化政策要求
nodes.rationale: IRA domestic-content requirements and DoD critical mineral sourcing mandates are the policy-driven demand layer; EV battery chemistry and defense magnets are the end markets.

nodes.label_zh: 稀土精炼加工（中国以外）
nodes.rationale: China dominates rare earth processing; Western ex-China refining capacity is the binding constraint on supply chain diversification.

nodes.label_zh: 关键矿产开采与加工商
nodes.rationale: Basket members are the direct beneficiaries of policy-driven demand for domestically sourced critical minerals.

nodes.label_en: Manufacturers dependent on Chinese rare earth supply
nodes.label_zh: 依赖中国稀土供应的制造商
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: Chinese export controls on rare earth processing intermediaries create supply disruption risk for manufacturers without diversified sourcing.

edges.rationale: Policy mandates translate to investment in Western processing capacity; early movers command pricing premium.
Processing capacity scarcity outside China advantages domestic/allied miners and refiners.
AVOID-shaped: manufacturers without diversified sourcing face input cost and supply continuity risk from Chinese export restrictions.

nodes.label_zh: 制造业回岸与电气化驱动的金属需求
nodes.rationale: IRA-driven manufacturing onshoring and AI/EV/grid electrification are the structural demand drivers for copper and specialty steel.

nodes.label_zh: 铜矿品位下降与许可
nodes.rationale: Secular ore-grade decline and 10-15 year mine-permit timelines constrain greenfield copper supply; recycled copper is insufficient to cover the gap.

nodes.label_zh: 铜生产商与回收商
nodes.rationale: Basket members include diversified metals producers with copper exposure that benefit from supply-constrained pricing.

nodes.label_zh: 依赖进口铜的制造商
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: manufacturers without domestic copper supply agreements face input cost headwinds from tariffs and price escalation.

edges.rationale: Demand growth outpacing constrained supply supports copper price; grade decline tightens the structural deficit.
Supply tightness converts to pricing power for producers with high-grade assets.
AVOID-shaped: tariff and price risk for manufacturers that have not secured domestic or allied copper supply.

nodes.label_en: Food security policy & nutrient price cycle
nodes.label_zh: 粮食安全政策与化肥价格周期
nodes.rationale: Global food security concerns, geopolitical supply disruptions (Russia/Belarus potash/urea), and biofuel mandates are structural demand drivers.

nodes.label_en: Natural gas input cost for nitrogen fertilizer
nodes.label_zh: 氮肥天然气原料成本
nodes.rationale: Natural gas is ~70-80% of nitrogen fertilizer production cost; price volatility is the primary margin swing factor for nitrogen producers.

nodes.label_zh: 化肥生产商（氮/钾/磷）
nodes.rationale: Fertilizer producers are direct beneficiaries when supply disruption or policy mandates tighten nutrient availability.

nodes.label_zh: 精准农业技术
nodes.rationale: Higher input costs accelerate precision agriculture adoption for nutrient optimization; ag-tech platforms benefit from cost-reduction urgency.

nodes.label_en: Food processors with thin margin exposure to ag input costs
nodes.label_zh: 农业投入成本高敞口的薄利食品加工商
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: fertilizer price spikes pass through to food processors with limited pricing power; margin compression risk is observable in cost-of-goods.

edges.rationale: Geopolitical supply disruptions translate to tighter nitrogen supply when gas cost does not deter production.
Supply tightness converts to pricing power for producers with low-cost gas access.
High input costs drive demand for nutrient-use-efficiency technology.
AVOID-shaped: food processors with commodity exposure face margin headwinds when fertilizer prices rise.

nodes.label_zh: 人口老龄化与手术量复苏
nodes.rationale: Post-COVID procedure backlog and aging demographics are structural tailwinds for medical device utilization; GLP-1 displacement is the countervailing risk.

nodes.label_zh: FDA许可与CE标志审批周期
nodes.rationale: Regulatory clearance timelines for novel devices are the primary constraint on new product cycle monetization.

nodes.label_zh: 外科器械与植入物制造商
nodes.rationale: Basket members capture procedure volume as the primary revenue driver for implants, surgical robotics, and capital equipment.

nodes.label_zh: 肥胖相关手术器械
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: GLP-1 adoption is reducing bariatric and related procedure volumes; device makers with high obesity-procedure concentration face structural headwinds.

edges.rationale: Procedure volume growth justifies regulatory investment; cleared devices capture pent-up demand.
Cleared devices command procedure utilization revenue.
AVOID-shaped: GLP-1 weight loss is measurably reducing elective bariatric procedure volumes.

nodes.label_en: Biopharma R&D spending & AI-driven drug discovery
nodes.label_zh: 生物制药研发支出与AI驱动药物发现
nodes.rationale: Biopharma R&D intensity driven by AI drug discovery platforms, GLP-1 pipeline expansion, and oncology is the demand driver for life-science tool vendors.

nodes.label_zh: 患者样本与生物样本库基础设施
nodes.rationale: Sample collection, consent, and biobanking capacity constrains the throughput of genomic and molecular diagnostic platforms.

nodes.label_zh: 诊断与生命科学工具供应商
nodes.rationale: Instrument, reagent, and informatics vendors are primary revenue recipients of R&D spending growth.

nodes.label_zh: 合同研究机构（CRO）
nodes.rationale: R&D outsourcing growth is a second-order tailwind for CROs; however, AI-driven productivity may compress headcount-based billing.

edges.rationale: Growing R&D throughput drives investment in sample infrastructure to feed diagnostic platforms.
Instrument and reagent demand flows to life-science tool vendors as the primary revenue recipients.
R&D growth drives CRO outsourcing demand; AI efficiency offsets are a countervailing risk.

nodes.label_en: IRA manufacturing credits & utility-scale PPA demand
nodes.label_zh: 美国通胀削减法案制造业抵税与公用规模购电协议需求
nodes.rationale: IRA Section 45X manufacturing credits and utility-scale PPA demand are the policy-driven demand framework; Chinese module oversupply is the structural countervailing force.

nodes.label_zh: 光伏逆变器与电网接入变压器
nodes.rationale: Inverter supply and grid-interconnection transformer availability are the project execution bottlenecks; lead times extended to 18-24 months for large transformers.

nodes.label_zh: 国内光伏组件与设备制造商
nodes.rationale: IRA 45X credits advantage domestic manufacturing over Chinese module imports; US-based producers capture the policy premium.

nodes.label_en: Chinese solar module exporters to the US
nodes.label_zh: 中国光伏组件出口商（面向美国市场）
nodes.rationale: AVOID-shaped: AD/CVD duties and potential tariff escalation under onshoring policy are structural headwinds for Chinese solar module exports to the US market.

edges.rationale: Project activity growth converts to inverter and transformer demand; scarcity advantages domestic suppliers.
Domestic manufacturers benefit from IRA credits and are the primary recipients of utility-scale module demand.
AVOID-shaped: tariff and policy barriers are a structural headwind for Chinese module market access in the US.
